hexcasting.mishap.hexquantum.no_illusion: I have no Illusion in this dimension
hexcasting.mishap.hexquantum.no_phial: needs my own Quantum Phial in my other hand
hexcasting.mishap.hexquantum.no_pocket_d: the pocket dimension is missing from this world
hexcasting.mishap.hexquantum.no_route: there is no recent movement to echo
hexcasting.mishap.hexquantum.vault_slot_: slot %s of my Phantom Vault is empty

a non-zero vector no longer than %s
hexquantum.page.cyclic_echo: An echo of me forever retracing my steps. One hit ends it.
hexquantum.page.cyclic_wisp: A mote of media that casts the same hex again and again.
hexquantum.page.delayed_echo: An intangible echo of me that waits, casts a hex once, and fades.
hexquantum.page.echo_cyclic: Creates an echo that endlessly retraces my last few seconds of movement, returning to the start each time. It dies in one hit.
hexquantum.page.echo_delayed: $(br)Leaves an intangible echo of myself here. After the given number of seconds it casts the given hex once from its own position, with itself on the stack, paid for with my media.
hexquantum.page.echo_personal: Leaves a motionless echo of myself here as a decoy. It has a single point of health.
hexquantum.page.illusion: My personal Illusion: a perfect copy of me that nothing can hurt or bump into.
hexquantum.page.illusion_dispel: Dispels my Illusion, if I have one.
hexquantum.page.illusion_summon: Creates my personal Illusion where I stand and pushes it. I may only have one; a new one replaces the old. It cannot be hurt and nothing collides with it, but hostile creatures chasing me may turn on it instead. It vanishes if I change dimension, leave the world, or dispel it.
hexquantum.page.illusion_swap: Instantly swaps my position with my Illusion's. The farther it is, the more media it costs, and beyond a certain range the swap fails.
hexquantum.page.link_distributed: Binds the given creatures with a magical beam: damage dealt to any of them is split evenly among all the living ones. When one dies, the rest share the burden.
hexquantum.page.link_shared: Binds the given creatures with a magical beam: whenever one is hurt, every other one takes the same damage.
hexquantum.page.media_rift: Tears open a rift into media itself and hands me a Quantum Phial bound to me. Any phial I made before stops working, though the media stored in it is not lost.
hexquantum.page.optics_mirror: $(br)For the given number of seconds, the given player sees a second, upside-down copy of the world mirrored at eye level. It is only light: nothing there can be touched.
hexquantum.page.optics_shifted: $(br)For the given number of seconds, the given player's view is displaced by the given offset. They aim and interact from where they seem to be, not from where they are.
hexquantum.page.personal_echo: A motionless decoy of me with a single point of health.
hexquantum.page.phantom_block: A block that is not there. It looks and feels like the block it copies, but vanishes when touched, or, if empowered, casts its maker's hex instead.
hexquantum.page.phantom_block_empowered: $(br)Like Phantom Block, but instead of vanishing it casts the given hex as me whenever it is touched, with whoever touched it on the stack.
hexquantum.page.phantom_item: A dropped item that is not there: it vanishes when anyone tries to pick it up.
hexquantum.page.phantom_item_empowered: $(br)Like Phantom Item, but picking it up also casts the given hex as me, with the picker on the stack.
hexquantum.page.phantom_mob: $(br)Conjures a see-through phantom of the given creature's kind at the given position. It behaves normally, but has half the health and deals half the damage. A phantom creeper's blast is weak and breaks nothing. Phantoms leave nothing behind.
hexquantum.page.phantom_mob_empowered: $(br)Like Phantom Mob, but the phantom is solid, at full strength, and betrayed only by faint particles. Whenever someone strikes or uses it, the given hex is cast as me from where it stands, with them on the stack.
hexquantum.page.phantom_storage_open: Lets me look into my Phantom Vault. Phantom items cannot be taken out by hand.
hexquantum.page.phantom_storage_release: $(br)Releases the phantom item in the given slot of my Phantom Vault (0 to 26) at the given position, and pushes it.
hexquantum.page.phantom_storage_store: Moves the given phantom item into my Phantom Vault, where it keeps without fading. An empowered phantom loses its hex.
hexquantum.page.phial_charge: With my Quantum Phial in my other hand, dissolves an amethyst item entity (dust, shards, charged crystals, blocks, clusters or buds) into the phial at the usual rate.
hexquantum.page.phial_read: Pushes how much media my Quantum Phial holds, in units of amethyst dust.
hexquantum.page.pocket_enter: Steps me onto my own platform in the pocket dimension, isolated from everyone else's. The place I left from is remembered.
hexquantum.page.pocket_exit_anchor: Pushes the dimension and position I last entered my pocket from, or two nulls if I never have. It only reads; nothing moves.
hexquantum.page.pocket_stash_open: Opens my Pocket Stash, a personal chest bound to my soul that I can reach from anywhere.
hexquantum.page.pocket_stash_store: Moves the given item entity into my Pocket Stash. Whatever does not fit stays where it was.
hexquantum.page.portal_door: Every pocket platform has one. Using it returns me to wherever I entered the pocket from.
hexquantum.page.projectile_wisp: A mote of media that flies straight and casts its hex where it strikes.
hexquantum.page.quantum_phial: A phial opened onto a rift in media itself, made by $(l:hexquantum/media_rift)Open Media Rift/$. It is bound to me alone and its capacity has no end. Whenever I cast with it anywhere in my inventory, the media is drawn from it first, before amethyst and before my own life. The media does not live in the glass but in me: if the phial is lost, a new one finds it all again, and I keep the phial when I die.
hexquantum.page.quantum_shift: For the given number of seconds I slip partly out of the world: I walk through walls, though floors still hold me unless I crouch. Creatures ignore me, projectiles pass through me and nothing can hurt me, but I cannot strike or touch the world. I can still cast. Casting it again ends the shift early, with no refund. If it ends inside a block I am pushed to the nearest free space.
hexquantum.page.wait: Pauses the hex for the given number of seconds (at most a minute), then carries on with the same stack. Leaving the world cancels the rest of the hex.
hexquantum.page.wisp_cyclic: $(br)$(br)Summons a wisp at the given position that casts the hex every given number of seconds, the given number of times, with itself on the stack. Each run costs me a little media on top of the hex itself.
hexquantum.page.wisp_projectile: $(br)Fires a wisp from my eyes with the given velocity (its length is the speed). When it strikes something it casts the hex there, with the entity it hit, or the centre of the block it hit, on the stack.
item.hexquantum.quantum_phial.desc: Its media lives in its owner, not in the glass.
